description: Business Planner. Turns your idea into a business plan investors can read: the nine sections (executive summary, problem, solution, market, competition, business model, go-to-market, financial plan, use of funds), written with you, with the numbers pulled from the other seed skills' files: TAM, SAM and SOM from seed/market.json, competitors' weak points from seed/competitors.json, revenue, breakeven and runway from seed/model.json. Computes the unit economics (take rate, contribution per order, CAC payback, LTV:CAC) and flags empty sections and numbers that disagree between files. Writes seed/config.json, seed/plan.json and seed/plan.md. Use when the user says "turn my idea into a business plan", "write my business plan", "I have a startup idea", "help me plan my startup", "check my plan", "unit economics", or before /seed-deck.
